sections.what_happened: US Central Command dismissed the IRGC's claim of downing/capturing US drones near Qeshm/Hormuz as false (Gulf News). The IRGC claims: 1 MQ-9 shot down east of the Strait of Hormuz ('55th MQ-9') + 2 MQM-170 reconnaissance drones brought down south of Qeshm by electronic warfare (total MQM-170 captures claimed: 4). The Pentagon has not confirmed any of the claims. Context note: the US Army describes the MQM-170 Outlaw as a target drone used in air-defense training (per prior reporting), and CENTCOM spokesman Tim Hawkins rejected an earlier MQM-170 capture claim on Oct 29.
sections.what_verified: Single-family relay (Gulf News T3) of a CENTCOM denial; direct CENTCOM statement not yet sighted this scan -- the denial is reported, not independently verified. IRGC claims themselves remain UNVERIFIED (no wreckage imagery, no US confirmation).
sections.what_disputed: IRGC/Press TV claims of 3 downed/captured drones stand directly against the CENTCOM denial; neither side has published wreckage imagery or a primary statement sighted this scan. Prior pattern: CENTCOM rejected an earlier MQM-170 capture claim Oct 29 (Hawkins).
sections.why_matters: Claim-bust frame (proven set): 'Iran claims 3 US drones down. CENTCOM says false. Here's what each side has actually shown: zero wreckage, zero confirmation.' Do NOT present either claim as fact.
